source: Claude Design "Cosmetics 01 v7" page, art v8 (13/10/2026) per NOTE-TO-CLAUDE-DESIGN-02 + REVIEW-cosmetics-v7
outline_rule: frames ≤ 64 px: outline #1A1206 at 2.3× weight; dice ≤ 40 px: ornament outlines #1A1206; die border black (Mythic #0E0608)

die_c_reed.name: Sunbaked Weave
spec: Border #000, 4 px at s=104 (3 px on the 36 px egg token).
Straw strands with an airbrushed gold gradient (#FFF0D0 → #F8C880), inner lines #E09050.
v7: inside the calm zone the weave lines run at 60 % contrast (40 % cream veil #FCEBCD → #FAE2B8 over the weave, under the rim), so the value row reads as one clean field at 36 px.
Braided rim along the bottom 15 px in orange #F8A858 / brown #A85038, maroon outline. Static.

die_c_sunwood.name: Driftwood Deck
spec: Border #000, 4 px.
Six sun-bleached planks (#FAEEDC → #EED6B0), seam #C89868 (7.0:1 to ink), wavy grain #DDB98C. Iron nails #8A6040 sit at x 5 and 99, outside the calm zone.
One cream sparkle top-right. Static.

die_c_clay.name: Kiln Clay
spec: Border #000, 4 px.
Baked clay (#F9E0C6 → #EDB892) pressed with five thumbprints, ridges #E2A47E (6.9:1 to ink).
Terracotta glaze rim along the bottom (#DE7A50 → #B04A2E, highlight #F4A07C), maroon outline. Static.

die_u_moss.name: Mossy Pebble
spec: Border #000, 4 px.
Cream river stones with an airbrushed top-left light (#FFFFFF → #E8DCC8) and soft brown inner line #C8A888 (6.6:1 to ink).
Frog-green moss along the bottom and sides (#60C878 → #40A888, vein #186048) with two broad leaves and a cream water-lily bud, borrowed from the lily-pad frame. Maroon outline. Static.

die_u_bark.name: Heartwood Rings
spec: Border #000, 4 px.
A cut log face (#F6E4C6 → #ECD2A8): growth rings #DDB888 radiate from the lower-left corner (6.0:1 to ink).
Bark rim along the bottom (#B8743E → #8A4A26, grooves #6A3418) with a two-leaf sprout. Static.

die_u_berry.name: Berry Jam
spec: Border #000, 4 px.
Cream icing (#FFF3F5 → #F8DCE4) with sugar dots #F2C6D4. Jam (#F0507A → #B8204E, shine #FFC0D0) pools along the bottom and drips down both side edges, outside the calm zone.
Two blueberries bottom-left, a raspberry with a mint leaf bottom-right. Static.

die_r_plant.name: Sprout Vine
spec: Border #000, 4 px.
Two materials: a spring-green field (#F2FBDC → #D8F0B4) printed with leaf silhouettes #BCE290 (12:1 to ink), plus a vine along the bottom (#5FA82A on maroon) carrying five chunky leaves.
A curled tendril top-right. Static.
v8: frost facet enlarged to Ø15.6 at s=104 (centre 14.5 / 91, flake r 5.8); stays below the calm zone (y > 83).
v7 Rare frost cue: cold-blue inner rim (#9FE4FF on #2A6FB0, white inner line) + a frost facet bottom-left, shared by all six class skins so the tier reads Arctic.

die_r_beast.name: Wildfur
spec: Border #000, 4 px.
Two materials: warm fur (#FFF3DE → #FFDEAE) with tuft strokes #F2C07C (9.7:1 to ink), plus a fluffy orange ruff along the bottom (#FFC35A → #E0861E, strands #B85A10).
Three claw slashes (#C8682A) top-right and a paw print top-left, both above the calm zone. Static.
v8: frost facet enlarged to Ø15.6 at s=104 (centre 14.5 / 91, flake r 5.8); stays below the calm zone (y > 83).
v7 Rare frost cue: cold-blue inner rim (#9FE4FF on #2A6FB0, white inner line) + a frost facet bottom-left, shared by all six class skins so the tier reads Arctic.

die_r_aqua.name: Tidepool
spec: Border #000, 4 px.
Scale field (#E0FAF4 → #90D8D0), scallop line #58C0B0, curling wave (#58C0B0 → #2E8C90) with cream foam.
v7: scallops inside the calm zone at 60 % contrast (40 % veil in the field gradient).
Rare frost cue: cold-blue rim (#9FE4FF on #2A6FB0) + frost facet bottom-left. Static.
v8: frost facet enlarged to Ø15.6 at s=104 (centre 14.5 / 91, flake r 5.8); stays below the calm zone (y > 83).

die_r_reptile.name: Scute Mosaic
spec: Border #000, 4 px.
Lilac hex-scale field (#F3EAFF → #DFCEF8), hex lines #C6ACEE; glossy scute row along the bottom (#B694FF → #7D4CE7). Lilac kept: Reptile is the purple class, the tier chip separates it from Epic.
v7: hex lines inside the calm zone at 60 % contrast (40 % veil).
Rare frost cue: cold-blue rim + frost facet bottom-left. Static.
v8: frost facet enlarged to Ø15.6 at s=104 (centre 14.5 / 91, flake r 5.8); stays below the calm zone (y > 83).

die_r_bug.name: Ladyshell
spec: Border #000, 4 px.
Blush carapace (#FFEEEA → #FCD6CE) with segment arcs in #F2AC9C; ladybird shell along the bottom (#FF6E5E → #D83A30).
v7: the centre seam is cut short and stops at y 44 (≈ 217 at 512), before the calm zone starts at 225.
Rare frost cue: cold-blue rim + frost facet bottom-left. Static.
v8: frost facet enlarged to Ø15.6 at s=104 (centre 14.5 / 91, flake r 5.8); stays below the calm zone (y > 83).

die_r_bird.name: Plume Fan
spec: Border #000, 4 px.

Two materials: sky down (#EFF9FF → #CFEEFF) with feather scallops #A2D6F2 (11:1 to ink), plus seven tail feathers fanned up from the bottom edge, alternating pink (#FFB0D4 → #E85A9A) and blue (#A8E6FF → #3AA8E8) with quills. Static.
v8: frost facet enlarged to Ø15.6 at s=104 (centre 14.5 / 91, flake r 5.8); stays below the calm zone (y > 83).
v7 Rare frost cue: cold-blue inner rim (#9FE4FF on #2A6FB0, white inner line) + a frost facet bottom-left, shared by all six class skins so the tier reads Arctic.

die_e_rune.name: Moonrune Tablet
spec: Border #4A1E8A (Mystic violet), 4 px.
Lavender tablet (#F4ECFF → #D8C4F4) with diagonal lilac stripes. Five runes carved in #8050C8 with a white lip, y 85 (below the calm zone).
v7: the rune row moved right/in (x 24–76) so no rune is cut by the gold scroll curls in the lower corners.
base.png: tablet, carved runes, scrolls, gems — no glow. glow.png: rune underlay #C898F0 5 px, blend Add; pulse 0.35→0.9, 2.0 s. Reduce flashing: 0.55→0.7.

die_e_spore.name: Glowshroom Grove
spec: Border #3B1A5C (deep Mystic), 4 px.
Moonlit mist field (#F3EFFF → #DDE6F6), violet toadstools in both lower corners on a plum moss rim (#7A60C8 → #4A3090).
v7: caps lowered — every cap top sits at y ≥ 82 (≈ 420 at 512), under the calm zone floor.

base.png: field, moss rim, toadstools — no halos, no spores. glow.png: mint halos #9AF0D8 behind each cluster + 7 floating spores (core #E8FFF8, rim #3AB89A), blend Add. Spores sit above the calm zone or at the side edges.
Idle: halos pulse 0.25→0.9 over 2.0 s; spores twinkle 2.0 s, staggered 0.3 s. Reduce flashing: halos 0.5→0.65, spores opacity only.

die_e_s1_founder.name: Founder’s Laurel
spec: Border #5A2A0A (dark bronze), 4 px.
Parchment (#FFF8E8 → #F4E2C0), faint star print #EBD5A8, laurel branches up both side edges (x ≤ 9, x ≥ 95).

v7: no lettering. The Season-1 shield above the value row carries a bold numeral “1” (Baloo-style block numeral drawn as a shape, cream #FFF4E0 with maroon outline) — readable at 36 px. The gold ribbon below is plain and shortened to x 16–88 so its tails clear the 92 px corner mask.
base.png: everything above, no stars. glow.png: the two gold corner stars; twinkle 2.0 s, offset 1.0 s. Reduce flashing: opacity only.

die_l_gold.name: Genesis Sunplate
spec: Border #7A3410 (burnt orange), 4 px.
Warm gold field (#FFF6DC → #FFE0A0) with engraved swirls #F0B868 above the calm zone.
v7: the sun sits lower (centre y 118 of 104) and its tallest blade ray stops at y 84 (≈ 430 at 512), below the calm zone floor at 410. Nothing rises into the value row.
base.png: field + sun + rays. glow.png: diagonal sheen, white 50 %, blend Add; sweeps in 1.1 s, rests, 3.2 s loop. Reduce flashing: sheen at 20 %.

die_l_relic_stone.name: Relic Seam
spec: Border #3A3020 (old stone), 4 px.
Running-bond stone blocks (#F3EFE6 → #DDD6C6, mortar #B4AA96) with chip marks; carved keystone at the bottom centre.
base.png: blocks + the seams as dark carved cracks (#8A7E68, 1.6 px) + an unlit keystone glyph. No glow in the base.

glow.png (blend Add): golden seams down both side edges and along the bottom — halo #FFC870 6 px at 55 %, edge #C8701A 2.6 px, core #FFF4C8 1.2 px — plus the lit sun glyph. Seams never enter the calm zone.
Idle: halo pulses 0.25→0.9, 2.4 s. Reduce flashing: 0.5→0.65.

die_l_kingdom.name: Lunacia Sovereign
die_l_kingdom.tag: Echo Box · pairs with Pass lv30 “LUNACIA SOVEREIGN”
spec: Border #24388A (royal navy), 4 px. Reads as black at 36 px.

Ivory damask (#FFFAF0 → #F6E8D0, diamond motif #EAD4AC at 12:1 to ink). Ornament: a royal-blue velvet hem (#4A68D8 → #24388A) under a gold trim line (#FFC93C on maroon), a gold crown (#FFE48A → #E8A020, ruby #E8304A, sapphires #3AC8F0) and four gold stars on the hem, gold filigree in the top corners.
base.png: damask, velvet hem, gold trim, crown, stars, filigree — no sheen. glow.png: diagonal white sheen 50 %, blend Add; sweeps in 1.2 s, rests, 3.6 s loop. Reduce flashing: sheen at 20 %.

die_m_redcrystal.name: Luna Heartcrystal
spec: Dark skin with a LIGHT VALUE PLATE (cream #FFF4E4 → #F4DCC4, 1.4 px maroon outline) sized to the calm zone. Ink #1A1206.
v7: border near-black #0E0608, 4 px, so the die keeps its outline on the night field at 36 px. Field: the shared Mythic night #2A0F2E (gradient #3A1442 → #2A0F2E) with cream star dust.
Signature: cream crescent moon with a teal gem; red crystals (#FF7E9C → #B8123E). v7: the two tall crystals carry a Luna Crimson #FF3D6E core.
base.png: field, moon, crystals, value plate. glow.png: 3 teal-rimmed sparkles, twinkle 1.6 s staggered (Reduce flashing: opacity only).
max.png (MAX settle, 0.6 s): full moon over the crescent + grown crystals (×1.15 from their base, ease-out-back). Reduced: crystals only.

die_m_moon.name: Moonface Dreamer
die_m_moon.tag: Echo Box · the moon disc is the value plate
spec: v7: border near-black #0E0608, 4 px (was night violet, lost at 36 px).

Field: the shared Mythic night #2A0F2E (gradient #3A1442 → #2A0F2E) with star dust. A full moon (r 52, centre 52/68; #FFF9EC → #F0DCC0, rim #E8A060) covers the calm zone, so the number sits on the moon.
Signature: sleeping moon face — closed eyes above the value row (y 39), blush at the sides, small smile below (y 92). Faint craters.

base.png: field, moon, face. glow.png: warm halo ring outside the moon (#FFE8B0) breathing 0.25→0.9 over 3.0 s + four blue-rimmed sparkles twinkling 1.6 s. Reduce flashing: halo 0.5→0.65, sparkles opacity only.
max.png (MAX settle, 0.8 s): eyes open (#6B2B2B pupils, cream catch-lights) and the halo flares to r 70. Reduced: eyes only.

frame_c_plant.name: Sprout Wreath
frame_c_plant.cue_40px: Wide flat leaf pair + big pink bud
spec: Static. Savannah band (shared Common).

v8 class motif at 12 o’clock, about 2× v7: two long flat leaves (58 px, #C2EC8E → #6CB04E) spread almost level to ±56 px, a stem and a big pink bud (r 12, #FFC0D0 → #E070A8) on top. 40 px read: a wide flat bar with a ball in the middle.

frame_c_beast.name: Fuzzy Ears
spec: Static. Savannah band (shared Common).
Class motif: two big rounded ears (#FFD27A → #E0861E, inner #FFD0C8 → #F0A0A0) at 10 and 2 o’clock — the widest top silhouette of the Common set. A paw print on the band at 7 o’clock.

frame_c_aqua.name: Tide Fin
frame_c_aqua.cue_40px: One fin leaning right + wave curl at 8
spec: Static. Savannah band (shared Common).
Class motif: a single dorsal fin at 1 o’clock leaning right (#8AF0F8 → #2EB0C8, rays #1A7A98) — the only asymmetric top in the set — and a wave curl with cream foam at 8 o’clock.

frame_c_reptile.name: Scute Ridge
spec: Static. Savannah band (shared Common).
Class motif: a comb of five rounded leaf-shaped scutes across the top arc (#D8B8FF → #8A5AE6, shine #F0E4FF), tallest in the middle. Rounded tips keep it apart from the Rare frost crown.

frame_c_bug.name: Antenna Ring
frame_c_bug.cue_40px: Two tall antennae, big red bulbs high up
spec: Static. Savannah band (shared Common).

v8 class motif, about 2× v7: two thick antennae (maroon 11 px, core #C8402E) rise and splay out to ±40 px, ending in big red bulbs (r 13, #FF8A70 → #D83A30) near the canvas top. Ladybird on the band at 4 o’clock. 40 px read: two balls on stalks, open in the middle.

frame_c_bird.name: Feather Crest
spec: Static. Drawn fresh in the shared line style (no Homeland bitmap used; only the composition idea of a top crest + a chick at 7 o’clock).

Savannah band (shared Common). v8 class motif, about 2× v7: a tall half-disc fan of five wide feathers (30–40 px; pink #FFB0D4 → #E85A9A outer and centre, blue #A8E6FF → #3AA8E8 inner pair) at 12 o’clock, and the sleeping pink chick at 7 o’clock. 40 px read: a solid half-disc on top.

frame_u_pond.name: Lily Pond
frame_u_pond.cue_40px: Frog on a lily pad at 11, lotus at 4
spec: Static. Drawn fresh in the shared line style (no Homeland bitmap used; only the frog-on-a-lily-pad idea).

Band: pond water (#B8ECF8 → #4AB0D8), ripple arcs #2A88B8, white gloss stroke. Forest cues: a lily pad (#9AE070 → #4A9A3A, veins #2E6A20) at 11 o’clock with a sitting frog (#9AE870 → #48A848, blush) on it, and a pink lotus at 4 o’clock.

frame_u_vine.name: Vine Wreath
spec: Static. Band: a twisted green vine (#9AD848 → #4E9A2C) with diagonal twist stripes #3E7A22.
Ten forest leaves (#B4F070 → #5AAA30, veins #2E6A18) all the way round, alternating out-left / out-right, plus three cream blossoms. The only fully leafy ring silhouette in the set.

frame_u_mushroom.name: Toadstool Log
frame_u_mushroom.cue_40px: Big toadstool at 2, small pair at 8
spec: Static. Band: a bark log (#D07848 → #A85038) with grain lines #7A3424 and a soft light on the upper left. Maroon outline.
A big toadstool cluster at 2 o’clock (caps #FF9C9C → #E0505A, cream spots, gills #F0C8A0) and a small pair at 8 o’clock; a clover sprig on top. The asymmetric clusters carry the 40 px read.

frame_u_campfire.name: Campfire Ring
spec: Static. Band: a ring of river stones (#E0D8C8 → #A89880, maroon outline) on a dark ash bed #6A5A4A — the only grey band in Uncommon.
At 12 o’clock two crossed logs (#C87840 → #8A4A26, cream ring ends) under a three-tongue campfire (outer #FF6A2B → #FFB03A, core #FFE27A). Two orange-rimmed sparks.

frame_r_frost.name: Frost Crown
frame_r_frost.cue_40px: Crown of five straight ice spikes
spec: Static. Two materials, after the steel tube of frame_2: a glossy periwinkle band (#F0F4FF → #B8C4EC) whose lower right turns to deep ice #8898D0, with blue lines #7088C8 and white gloss strokes; and ice crystals.
An ice crown of five faceted spikes on top (#F6FBFF → #9FD8F0, facets #60A8D0). This is the 40 px silhouette cue.
A round snowflake medallion at 6 o’clock (#C8F0FF → #70C0E8, white flake) and three blue-rimmed sparkles.
Arctic read: periwinkle and ice blues only; no green anywhere in the Rare set.

frame_r_snowglobe.name: Snow Globe
frame_r_snowglobe.cue_40px: Navy pedestal at 6, snow cap at 12
spec: Static. Band: clear glass (#F6FCFF → #C6E6F8) with white snow flecks and two gloss strokes, maroon outline.
A wide navy pedestal under the globe (#5A7AC8 → #2A4A8A, gold trim #FFC93C, snowflake emblem) — the only bottom-heavy Rare silhouette. A lumpy snow cap on top.

frame_r_aurora.name: Aurora Veil
frame_r_aurora.cue_40px: Dark band + flowing ribbons over the top
spec: Static. Band: Arctic night (#3A5AA8 → #1E2E68) with star dust — the only dark Rare band.
Two aurora ribbons sweep over the top outside the band (cyan #8AF4FF → violet #C49CFF and pink #FFB0E0 → periwinkle #9AB4FF). No green, so the frame never reads as Uncommon. Blue-rimmed sparkles.
v8 check: ribbon tips reach r ≈ 126 (y ≈ 2 at the top); nothing touches the 256 canvas edge.

frame_r_icicle.name: Icicle Fringe
spec: Static. v8 band: pale ice blue (#B8E2FF → #5EA8E6), line #3A7EC0, white gloss — a clear colour block apart from the white Snow Globe.

Ten long, wide icicles hang outward round the whole lower half (22–32 px, half-width 8°, #F6FCFF → #7CC0EE, white glint), three snow lumps on top. 40 px read: blue ring with a spiky bottom fringe, versus Snow Globe’s white ring on a solid navy base.

frame_e_runering.name: Rune Ring
frame_e_runering.cue_40px: Double ring with four gem studs
spec: A rune ring, not a bowl. Base (static): violet stone band (#C8A0F8 → #7A50C8) with eight carved runes (cream #FFF4E4 over #5A3098), four teal gem studs at 12/3/6/9 (#B8F8D8 → #48D8A8), and a thin outer orbit ring (r 108–113) tied on with four lilac clasps. Gold scroll curls flank the top gem. Mystic palette from the biome sheet (lavender ground, teal rock).
loop: frames/frame_e_runering_rune_orbit.png: six glowing runes (#F4E4FF, violet halo) ride the outer orbit ring, 360° in 16 s, linear, seamless.
frames/frame_e_runering_rune_glow.png: the eight band runes glow 0.25→0.9 and back, 2.0 s ease-in-out.
Reduce flashing: glow 0.5→0.65; orbit slowed to 24 s (no brightness change).

frame_e_firefly.name: Firefly Grove
frame_e_firefly.cue_40px: Dark branch ring, pink blossoms at 2 and 8
spec: Base (static): a twisted plum branch band (#8A5AAA → #4A2A6A, bark lines #2E1648), coral-pink blossom puffs from the Mystic trees (#FFB0B8 → #E86880) at 2 and 8 o’clock, and a small gold lantern (#E8B040, glass #FFF0A0) hanging at 4 o’clock.
loop: frames/frame_e_firefly_fireflies.png: seven fireflies (core #FFFBD0, halo #F8F07A) drift round the frame on three rings (r 112 / 118 / 124) at 10, 14 and 18 s per lap, never inside the window. Each twinkles 1.6 s, staggered.
frames/frame_e_firefly_lantern_glow.png: lantern glow 0.3→0.8, 2.4 s.
Reduce flashing: fireflies by opacity only (0.6→1, no scale pop), lantern 0.5→0.65.

frame_e_s1_founder.name: Founder’s Laurel
spec: Base (static): bronze-gold band (#FFE08A → #D9962A, engraved line #B87010), laurel branches (#B4E070 → #6AA02A) climbing both sides to the top, an orange shield at 12 o’clock (#FFB060 → #D9601A) with a bold block numeral “1” drawn as a shape (no font), and Mystic-violet ribbon tails at 6 o’clock (#C8A0FF → #7A4AC8). Pairs with die_e_s1_founder.
loop: frames/frame_e_s1_founder_stars.png: two gold stars beside the shield twinkle, 2.0 s, offset 1.0 s.
frames/frame_e_s1_founder_shield_sheen.png: a white sheen crosses the shield, 0.6 s, then rests; 3.0 s loop.
Reduce flashing: stars by opacity only, sheen at 20 %.

frame_l_sunburst.name: Genesis Sunburst
spec: A gold sun, not silver gears. Base (static): slim gold tube band (#FFE6A8 → #F0B860, inner line #E08838, white gloss), a sun disc (#FFE8A0 → #F8A048, swirl #E07828) between two pairs of gold blade wings (#FFC870 → #F07828) at 12 o’clock, a gold scroll cuff at 8 and a hanging orange star at 3. fx_l_sunfire reuses this crest.
loop: frames/frame_l_sunburst_sun_glow.png: sun-disc glow #FFF0C0, opacity 0.2→0.85, 2.4 s ease-in-out.
frames/frame_l_sunburst_sparkles.png: three teal-rimmed sparkles twinkle 1.6 s, staggered 0.5 s.
Reduce flashing: glow 0.5→0.65, sparkles by opacity only.

frame_l_sovereign.name: Lunacia Sovereign
spec: Base (static): royal navy band (#5A78E8 → #24388A) with gold trim lines on both edges (#FFC93C on maroon) and six gold studs; a big gold crown at 12 o’clock (#FFE48A → #E8A020, ruby #E8304A, sapphires #3AC8F0, pearl tips); gold star medallions at 4 and 8. Navy colour block + crown keep it apart from the gold sunburst at 40 px. Pairs with die_l_kingdom.
loop: frames/frame_l_sovereign_crown_sheen.png: white sheen crosses the crown in 0.8 s, then rests; 3.6 s loop.
frames/frame_l_sovereign_gem_glints.png: ruby and sapphires glint (4-point sparkles), 1.6 s, staggered.
Reduce flashing: sheen at 20 %, glints by opacity only.

frame_m_eclipse.name: Luna Eclipse
frame_m_eclipse.cue_40px: Cream crescent between crimson crystal wings + crimson sash
spec: Mythic palette: night #2A0F2E + Luna Crimson #FF3D6E. Base (static): night band (#4A1A50 → #2A0F2E) with cream star dust; crescent moon crest kept on top (#FFF8EC → #F0D4B8, teal gem) between two pairs of crimson crystal wings (#FF7E9C → #B8123E, #FF3D6E cores); a crimson silk sash over the lower half (#FF6A8A → #B8184A, gold grain #FFD76A); a three-crystal knot at 6 o’clock.
Never white or cream text on #FF3D6E; this frame carries no text.
loop: frames/frame_m_eclipse_eclipse.png: a night shadow disc (#2A0F2E, 85 %) slides across the crescent left → right over 6 s (in 2 s, hold 1 s, out 2 s, rest 1 s); a gold corona ring (#FFD76A) shows while it covers.
frames/frame_m_eclipse_sparkles.png: four teal-rimmed sparkles twinkle 1.6 s, staggered.
Reduce flashing: no corona pulse (corona fixed at 40 %), sparkles by opacity only; the slide is kept (no brightness change).

frame_m_crystal.name: Heartcrystal Crown
frame_m_crystal.cue_40px: Tall crimson crystal spikes on moonstone
spec: Mythic palette. Base (static): pale moonstone band (#F4F0F8 → #B8B0C8, cracks #8A80A0) like the grey rocks round the LunaLanding crystals; a night-plum backing (#2A0F2E, cream star dust) behind a fan of five crimson crystals at 12 o’clock (#FF7E9C → #B8123E, #FF3D6E cores), smaller clusters pointing out at 4 and 8, grey stone chunks at their feet.
Tall spiky top vs Luna Eclipse’s crescent + sash: the two Mythic frames differ at 40 px in silhouette and in colour block (pale stone vs night band).
loop: frames/frame_m_crystal_core_glow.png: a crimson glow (#FF3D6E) behind the top fan breathes 0.25→0.8, 2.4 s.
frames/frame_m_crystal_glint.png: a white glint runs up the tallest crystal, 0.5 s, every 3 s.
Reduce flashing: glow 0.5→0.65, glint at 40 %.

fx_c_dust.name: Dust Devil
spec: Trail: cartoon dust clouds (3-lobe puffs, sand #F7DE9A, shade #D99A2B, 2.5 px black ring) pop in behind the die every 60 ms (scale 0→1→0.7, 0.35 s), plus 2 speed streaks per bounce arc.
Impact: a cloud pair bursts left and right along the felt and a sand ring spreads flat on the felt (ground ellipse r 30→90, 0.4 s).
Settle (signature): a flat sand shockwave ring rolls out on the felt and two big clouds pop at the die’s feet. 8 bits [face type, sand].
Peak ≈ 22 / die. No luminance pulses, so the reduced variant is identical.

fx_c_leaf.name: Leaf Tumble
spec: Trail: one leaf every 70 ms (sizes 8–11, #9AD860 / #F0C040 / #E88A30, maroon ring) drifts down and flips (scale-Y flutter).
Impact: 4 leaves pop up and flutter down on light gravity; a flat green ring spreads on the felt.
Settle (signature): 8 leaves burst from an arc 80 px above the die and drift outward; a wide green felt ring (r 50→170). 8 bits [face type, leaf green], spawned first.
v7: Peak ≤ 34 / die (hard cap, was 40). The face-type bits spawn first in the settle, so a full budget never drops them. No luminance change, so the reduced variant is identical.

fx_c_pebble.name: Skipping Stones
spec: Trail: a pebble (#C8BCA8 / #A89880 / #D8CCB4, maroon ring, cream glint) drops off the die every 90 ms.
Impact: 3 pebbles skip along the felt (each bounces at 50 % energy) and a small sand cloud puffs.
Settle (signature): 6 pebbles skip outward from |x| 60–80 and 2 sand clouds pop at the die’s feet; flat sand ring on the felt. 8 bits [face type, stone], spawned first.
Peak ≈ 24 / die. Reduced: identical.

fx_u_petal.name: Petal Waltz
spec: Trail: pink petals (#FFB0CC / #FF8AB0 / #FFE0EA) shed every 40 ms on a sine sway, flipping as they fall.
Impact: a fan of 6 petals opens upward from the felt.
Settle (signature): 12 petals appear on a ring (r 85 × 70) around the die and spin away tangentially like a waltz; a flat pink felt ring. 8 bits [face type, petal], spawned first.
v7: Peak ≤ 34 / die (hard cap, was 40). The face-type bits spawn first in the settle, so a full budget never drops them. Reduced: identical.

fx_u_splash.name: Puddle Jump
spec: Trail: water drops (#7ADCFF / #3AB4F0 / #D8F6FF, teardrop pointing back along the motion) flick off every 50 ms and fall.
Impact: a 6-drop crown splash and a flat blue ring.
Settle (signature): two crown splashes rise at x ±64–96 (10 drops, up to 380 px/s) and two ripple rings spread on the felt (blue r 60→190, white r 40→130). 8 bits [face type, water], spawned first.
v7: Peak ≤ 34 / die (hard cap, was 40). The face-type bits spawn first in the settle, so a full budget never drops them. Reduced: identical.

fx_u_ember.name: Campfire Crown
spec: Trail: a ribbon of flame tongues (teardrops, #FF6A2B outer / #FFD23F core, black ring) shed every 35 ms that shrink and lift, plus embers.
Impact: a flame flower (5 tongues fanned up from the felt) and 6 embers on gravity.

Settle (signature): a crown of 7 flame tongues flickers around the die’s base for 0.35 s (12 fps flicker, 3 shapes), then pops into embers. 8 bits [face type, #FFB23F]. Tongues sit at x ≥ ±62, so the face stays clear.
Peak ≈ 30 / die. v7 Reduced: the flame crown holds one fixed flame shape for its 0.35 s (no 12 fps shape swap); embers unchanged.

fx_r_frost.name: Glacier Bloom
spec: Trail: snowflakes and ice glints drift off the die.
Impact: 3 ice spikes erupt from the felt (Ice ramp, two-face toon), hold 0.3 s, then shatter into shards. A small snow cloud puffs.

Settle (signature): a ring of 6 ice spikes bursts out of the felt around the die (ground ellipse r 95), holds 0.35 s, then shatters outward. A frost ring spreads flat on the felt. v7: 8 bits [face type, ice #8FE8FF], spawned first.
Spikes stay at |x| ≥ 70 from the die centre, so the face is never covered.
Peak ≈ 34 / die. Reduced: identical.

fx_r_bubble.name: Bubble Stream
spec: Trail: bubbles rise and wobble off the die every 40 ms (grow 5→12, rim #7ADCFF on maroon, fill 28 %, white catch-light).
Impact: 5 bubbles float up from the felt.
Settle (signature): one big bubble swells behind the die (r 40→80) and pops into 6 droplet lines; 10 bubbles rise in two columns at |x| 66–110. 8 bits [face type, bubble], spawned first.
v7: Peak ≤ 34 / die (hard cap, was 40). The face-type bits spawn first in the settle, so a full budget never drops them. Reduced: identical (no brightness change).

fx_r_spark.name: Static Snap
spec: Trail: short zig-zag bolts (maroon 7 px, #FFE84A 3.6 px, white 1.2 px core) crackle behind the die every 60 ms + yellow sparks.
Impact: 3 bolts run flat along the felt; yellow ring.
Settle (signature): 6 bolts snap outward from r 72 to r 120–150 around the die, re-jagged at 24 fps for 0.35 s, plus 6 sparks. 6 bits [face type, #FFE84A], spawned first.
Reduced: bolts keep one fixed shape (no re-jag), so nothing flickers.
Peak ≈ 28 / die.

fx_e_rune.name: Summoning Circle
spec: Trail: spore wisps #BF6BFF (35 % halo) and floating rune glyphs.
Impact: a small rune ring flashes flat on the felt (ellipse r 40, 0.3 s).

Settle (signature): a magic circle draws itself on the felt under the die (outer ring sweeps 0→360° in 0.25 s, 6 runes pop in sequence, rotates 30°). A violet light pillar rises behind the die (35 %) and runes float up its edges. 0.9 s total. v7: 8 bits [face type, #BF6BFF], spawned first. Circle and pillar sit behind the die face and never cover the value.
Reduced: pillar 15 %, halos 50 %, the circle does not pulse.

fx_e_spore.name: Glowshroom Bloom
spec: Trail: mint (#5AE0C0) and violet (#BF6BFF) spore wisps with 35 % halos.
Impact: two small toadstools pop up on the felt at x ±36 and sink.

Settle (signature): 5 glowing toadstools sprout around the die (|x| 86–152, ease-out-back 0.16 s, 0.05 s stagger), mint halos behind each; 10 spores rise from them. 0.9 s. 8 bits [face type, mint], spawned first.
Reduced: halos at 50 %.
Peak ≈ 30 / die.

fx_l_sunfire.name: Genesis Crest
spec: Trail: comet ribbon from the last 14 die positions (maroon 22 px, #F8A048 16 px, #FFC870 8 px core, tapered) plus gold sparkles.
Impact: a flat gold ring spreads on the felt (r 30→90) and two small orange-rimmed stars hop out.

Settle (signature): v7 matches the new gold-sun frame_l_sunburst — the same crest rises behind the die: sun disc (#FFE8A0 → #F8A048, swirl #E07828) between two pairs of gold blade wings (#FFC870 → #F07828) that flex 6 %. Four orange-rimmed stars blink around it. 0.9 s. 10 bits [face type, #FFC870], spawned first. Gold tint 0.25 for 0.2 s on the tray felt only, never over the die face.
Reduce flashing: no tint, stars blink by scale only.
Peak ≈ 30 / die.

fx_l_starfall.name: Royal Starfall
spec: Trail: a 3-layer navy-gold comet ribbon (maroon 22 px, #3A58C8 15 px, #FFE48A 7 px) + gold stars with navy rims + white streaks.
Impact: a gold felt ring and two hopping stars.

Settle (signature): 5 shooting stars dive in from the upper right (0.3 s each, 0.07 s stagger), land around the die (never within 52 px of the face) and stay as twinkling gold stars; gold felt ring; gold tint 0.15 for 0.2 s. 10 bits [face type, gold], spawned first.
Reduce flashing: no tint, landed stars do not blink.
Peak ≈ 30 / die.

fx_m_lunar.name: Luna Crest
spec: Rebuilt as the Mythic signature. No ice spikes, no shatter, nothing shared with Glacier Bloom. All Mythic layers run at full 60 fps; every lower tier animates on twos (12 fps), so the motion itself reads as premium.
Trail: a 4-layer crimson-gold ribbon (maroon 26 px, #7A1030 20, #FF3D6E 13, #FFD76A 5 core) + two afterimages of the die (32 % / 18 %) + tumbling gold crescents and crimson-rimmed star dust.
Impact: a flat crimson/gold double ring on the felt and 3 gold stars hop out.

Settle (every roll): a celestial dial opens behind the die (crimson ring r 96, gold ring r 84, 12 ticks, 3 gems, 4 crescents, rotating), a gold constellation draws itself on both sides (6 stars, |x| ≥ 96 from centre), and a light sheen crosses the die face once in 0.22 s (v7: ≤ 0.25 s). v7: 10 bits [face type, #FF3D6E, #FFD76A], spawned first.

MAX (blood-moon eclipse, 1.9 s): v7 — the night dim (60 %) falls only on the tray felt under the dice; dice, value plates and HUD stay at full brightness. One eclipse per roll: when several dice roll MAX together, a single shared eclipse plays behind the tray centre; each extra MAX die gets only its dial and bits. Then: crimson moon rises with slow god rays, a plum shadow slides across until a gold corona is left, a diamond-ring sparkle pops, 6 gold crescents orbit and a shooting star crosses the tray.
Reduce flashing: 30 % felt dim, rays and corona glow at half, sheen at 50 %, no diamond-ring blink.
Peak ≈ 36 / die on MAX (each big layer is one particle).

changes_v8: Common frame_c_plant / frame_c_bug / frame_c_bird: class motif ~2x, distinct top silhouettes (flat leaf bar + bud / two bulbs on stalks / half-disc feather fan).
Rare frame_r_icicle: pale ice-blue band + longer, wider icicles; now a different colour block from frame_r_snowglobe.
Epic+ frames: moving layers exported as separate 256x256 PNGs, frames/frame_<id>_<layer>.png (static pose, same canvas and centre as base). *_anim.png kept as combined preview only.
Rare dice (6): frost facet enlarged to ~16 px at 104 (centre 14.5/91), still below the calm zone.
New preview: frames_preview_40_96_256.png (all 21 frames around a dummy avatar).
Per frame: image_size [256,256] and window_radius_px 84 added for loader validation.
No frame uses Homeland_Avatar bitmaps; c_bird and u_pond were drawn fresh (only the composition idea was taken).

animated_layers.note: v8: separate layers, driven by CosmeticArt from frames.<id>.anim (type spin|pulse|sweep). Reduce flashing = MetaState.reduce_flash. Frames in px/256 units for dx/dy. Single-image layers cannot stagger individual sparkles/fireflies; the whole layer twinkles together.
